records.name: agentic-harness
records.source_text: Stand up, assess, and maintain an agentic harness in an existing repo. A meta-tool that generates project-specific agent teams and the skills they use, then assesses how effectively they are used. When a spec-driven development system or an issue tracker is present, the generated orchestrator coordinates with it — activating the spec workflow and resuming on hand-back, pulling ready work and writing status back. When a repo-native tracker and a human tracker (Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues) coexist, it generates a dual-tracker sync that keeps the SaaS as a projection of the repo-native source of truth. Five skills: harness-setup (build, extend, maintain), harness-review (read-only assessment), harness-feedback (run a kaizen retrospective and file tool-improvement feedback upstream), spec-advisor (advise and delegate setup of a spec-driven development system), and tracker-advisor (advise and delegate setup of an agent-suited issue tracker).
records.translation: 在现有存储库中建立、评估和维护代理工具。一种元工具，可生成特定于项目的代理团队及其使用的技能，然后评估他们的使用效率。当存在规范驱动的开发系统或问题跟踪器时，生成的编排器会与其协调 - 激活规范工作流程并恢复手回，拉出准备好的工作并将状态写回。当 repo-native 跟踪器和人工跟踪器（Jira、Linear、GitHub Issues）共存时，它会生成双跟踪器同步，使 SaaS 保持作为 repo-native 事实来源的投影。五项技能：线束设置（构建、扩展、维护）、线束审查（只读评估）、线束反馈（运行改善回顾并向上游提交工具改进反馈）、规范顾问（建议和委托设置规范驱动的开发系统）和跟踪器顾问（建议和委托设置适合代理的问题跟踪器）。
records.summary_zh: 在现有仓库建立并评估智能体执行环境，生成项目专用团队与技能，结合规格或问题跟踪系统检查其使用效果。

records.name: ai adoption
records.source_text: AI Adoption, three skills for working with your Claude history. token-doctor diagnoses where your Claude Code + Cowork spend goes (length distribution, marathon share, cache rebuilds, per-project health), writes a doctor-style terminal report, and optionally fans out parallel Haiku subagents over your top sessions for habit-level recommendations. task-profile mines those same sessions into a structured task profile: what you do with AI, how often, how successfully, where friction lives; it emits a shareable CSV, an interactive HTML explorer with progressive disclosure and a code-vs-cowork token chart, AI-first coaching cards, and up to five task-centric skill proposals. session-search finds a specific past session by title, working directory, time range, or free-text content across every Claude Code and Cowork transcript on disk.
records.translation: 人工智能采用，处理克劳德历史的三项技能。 token-doctor 诊断您的 Claude Code + Cowork 支出去向（长度分布、马拉松份额、缓存重建、每个项目的运行状况），编写医生式的终端报告，并可选择在您的顶级会话上扇出并行俳句子代理以获取习惯级别的建议。任务配置文件将这些相同的会话挖掘到结构化的任务配置文件中：您使用人工智能做什么，频率如何，成功程度如何，摩擦存在于何处；它会发出可共享的 CSV、具有渐进式披露功能的交互式 HTML 浏览器、代码与协作令牌图表、人工智能优先的辅导卡以及最多五个以任务为中心的技能建议。会话搜索按标题、工作目录、时间范围或磁盘上每个 Claude Code 和 Cowork 记录中的自由文本内容查找特定的过去会话。
records.summary_zh: 分析 Claude Code 与 Cowork 的历史会话，诊断令牌费用、提取任务画像并形成使用习惯建议，输出终端报告。
records.original_summary_zh: 主要用于助手配置与技能，可查找“AI使用与思考方法”相关技能或服务。具体操作范围见包内说明。

records.name: apodictic
records.source_text: APODICTIC Development Editor. A development editor for fiction and argument-shaped nonfiction — reads what you wrote, diagnoses structure, never rewrites. For nonfiction, the Argument Engine infers your claim, audience, and burden, then finds missing warrants, scope drift, and unmet objections in op-eds, policy briefs, testimony, academic arguments, legal briefs, and regulatory comments, with Dialectical Clarity, Red Team, Persuasion, Evidence, Field Reconnaissance, and Citation Verifier companions. For fiction: structural diagnosis, genre calibration, tag audits, plot architecture analysis, and pre-writing. Shared: revision coaching, partial manuscript diagnostic, fragment synthesis, and intake routing across 11 core passes, 38 available audits (3 universal, 20 craft, 10 genre, 5 tag), 6 research modes, 1 pre-writing pathway, and 1 intake router. Includes contract-driven and finding-driven audit integration pipeline.

records.name: archlens
records.source_text: Turn a codebase or an architecture document into a structured, evidence-carrying analysis, then compile that analysis into validated interactive diagrams and a matching markdown document. Ask "map this architecture with archlens", point it at a design document as the only source, or ask one question with /archlens <question> to get a single diagram — an architecture, or a sequence when the question is about an order of events — that answers it; with an analysis in place, plain questions are answered from it with evidence, or refused when it does not cover them; a change can be reviewed against the analysis, a first draft seeded from a compose file or a workspace, drift and ruled constraints checked in CI, and two analyses compared. One diagram per question, source links verified against git, and everything the picture had to drop reported rather than hidden. Requires the archify renderer (npx skills add tt-a1i/archify -g).
records.translation: 将代码库或架构文档转换为结构化的、有证据的分析，然后将该分析编译为经过验证的交互式图表和匹配的 Markdown 文档。询问“使用 archlens 映射此架构”，将其指向作为唯一来源的设计文档，或者使用 /archlens <question> 提出一个问题以获得一个单一图表 - 一个架构，或者当问题是关于事件顺序时的一个序列 - 来回答它；分析到位后，简单的问题就会得到证据的回答，或者当分析不涵盖这些问题时就会被拒绝；可以根据分析来审查更改，从撰写文件或工作区中生成初稿，在 CI 中检查漂移和规则约束，并对两个分析进行比较。每个问题一张图表，根据 git 验证源链接，以及图片必须报告的所有内容而不是隐藏。需要 archify 渲染器（npx 技能添加 tt-a1i/archify -g）。
records.summary_zh: 从代码库或架构文档提取带证据的结构化分析，编译为经过校验的交互图与对应 Markdown 文档，支持指定来源问答。

Ask "map this architecture with archlens", point it at a design document as the only source, or ask one question with /archlens <question> to get a single diagram — an architecture, or a sequence when the question is about an order of events — that answers it; with an analysis in place, plain questions are answered from it with evidence, or refused when it does not cover them; a change can be reviewed against the analysis, a first draft seeded from a compose file or a workspace, drift and ruled constraints checked in CI, and two analyses compared. One diagram per question, source links verified against git, and everything the picture had to drop reported rather than hidden. Requires the archify renderer (npx skills add tt-a1i/archify -g).

records.name: aws startups solution architecture
records.source_text: Technical AWS solutions for the problems startups get stuck on, from the AWS Startups Solution Architecture team. Multi-tenant SaaS isolation enforced in IAM rather than application code, and running a judgment agent such as an LLM reviewer inside a CI path. Startup here means the technical constraints are startup constraints: no dedicated platform or security team, a cost ceiling that is someone's runway, and a deadline that is a funding milestone. Draws all general-purpose AWS service depth from Agent Toolkit for AWS as an upstream dependency rather than restating it.
records.translation: AWS 初创公司解决方案架构团队针对初创公司遇到的问题提供了 AWS 技术解决方案。在 IAM（而不是应用程序代码）中强制实施多租户 SaaS 隔离，并在 CI 路径内运行判断代理（例如 LLM 审阅者）。这里的启动意味着技术限制就是启动限制：没有专门的平台或安全团队，成本上限是某人的跑道，最后期限是融资里程碑。从 Agent Toolkit for AWS 中提取所有通用 AWS 服务深度作为上游依赖项，而不是重述它。

records.name: claude for financial advisors
records.source_text: Ready-to-run workflows for financial advisors in Claude Cowork, drawing live data from the tools their firm already uses through third-party connectors. The plugin holds no client data, and the advisor approves any write back to an external system. Claude gathers, organizes, summarizes, compares and presents information, while the advisor exercises judgment, makes the recommendation and gives the advice. For financial professional use only; not investment, legal, or tax advice.
records.translation: Claude Cowork 中的财务顾问可立即运行工作流程，通过第三方连接器从公司已使用的工具中提取实时数据。该插件不保存客户端数据，并且顾问批准任何写回外部系统的操作。克劳德收集、组织、总结、比较和呈现信息，而顾问则进行判断、提出建议并给出建议。仅供金融专业人士使用；不是投资、法律或税务建议。

records.name: deep refactor
records.source_text: Audit-and-ship workflows for Claude Code: deep-refactor (codebase-wide audit, evidence-backed report, sequenced ticket train, PR drain preserving the test contract), test-refactor (per-suite test audit with production code frozen — dead-test deletion with evidence, parametrized merges, single-parallel-run isolation, per-module coverage parity), and doc-refactor (whole markdown surface audited with the source frozen — false claims first, deliberate replication kept in sync, generated docs never hand-edited, trigger phrases never subtracted, per-file operative-token diffs on every compression). Pins inventoried before proposing, claims measured or executed not inferred, non-vacuity proofs on every touched guard, no merge without a self-verified green run.
records.translation: Claude Code 的审计和发布工作流程：深度重构（代码库范围审计、有证据支持的报告、有序票证序列、保留测试合同的 PR 流失）、测试重构（冻结生产代码的每套件测试审计 — 带证据的死测试删除、参数化合并、单并行运行隔离、每个模块覆盖奇偶校验）和文档重构（在源代码冻结的情况下审计整个 Markdown 表面 — 首先是虚假声明，保留故意复制）同步地，生成的文档永远不会手工编辑，触发短语永远不会被减去，每个文件的操作令牌在每次压缩时都有差异）。在提出建议之前对引脚进行盘点，测量或执行的索赔不是推断的，每个接触的防护装置上都有非空证明，没有自我验证的绿色运行就不会合并。
records.summary_zh: 审查代码库和测试套件，生成带证据的报告与顺序工单，推进 PR 修订；测试整理保持生产代码和覆盖约束。
records.original_summary_zh: 主要用于代码质量，可查找“代码检索、讲解与重构”相关技能或服务。具体操作范围见包内说明。

records.name: design steward
records.source_text: Design Steward takes a website or app from design feedback to a verified fix. Mark up a live page with notes, drawings and preview edits, then turn that feedback into a clear list of issues with testable acceptance criteria. Check which design rules your project has actually settled on and where its docs and code disagree, update the docs once you decide, and make the changes with a progress log you can pause and resume. Finally, confirm each fix at the screen sizes you care about. records.name: ecoctx
records.source_text: ecoctx audits the context your coding agent loads on every turn - CLAUDE.md, indexes, every installed skill's description - and measures what each costs in tokens.
